selection: One genuinely unseen full year, 2025, five metals; all five retained including acquisition failure. Reject 2024 due to prior annual2024 document exposure. Audit document hashes AND assertion keys/notes/comparatives before eligibility. If no fresh paired year, separately label extraction-transfer only.
arms: Python templates with timed manual preparation or abstention
same Python plus OpenAI Decisions gpt-6-luna
gate_rules: Require explicit same mine/full-year/100% output/product-stage/metal; convertible explicit units; identify version/preliminary status without implying final approval. Document bucket is not claim period. Missing evidence => insufficient evidence; explicit conflict => invalid comparison. Metal in concentrate is distinct from concentrate mass; sales/payable/equity production is not 100% mine output. Missing/dash never zero. No proportional annualization. No model arithmetic or wrongdoing inference.
arithmetic: Decimal; t/kt factor 1000; oz/koz factor 1000; MMoz factor 1000000; tonne/lb factor 0.00045359237; troy oz/kg factor 0.0311034768; compatible metal dimensions required; tolerance sum of one displayed unit per source (inherited convention); quantities only after all gates.
threshold: Jev and Decisions categorical highest-probability choice per gate; confidence does not certify evidence; all gates must be supported. Unknown preserved.
reference_review: Source-grounded investigator/assistant review recorded before arm outputs; no human gold labels, and same assistant preparation/reference is not independent blind human review. Never use confidence as truth.
metrics: correct evidenced comparisons / all frozen targets
provider charge estimate / actual invoice availability
no_tuning: Rules and prompts freeze before new-year source answer inspection; any fixes marked development and affected results disclosed.
